caption: The drawing depicts a transparent drinking glass with a flared rim, adorned with colorful decorative patterns. Around the top and bottom portions of the glass are horizontal red bands. In between these bands are rows of alternating red dots, white curling lines forming symmetrical swirls, and stylized blue and green leaf motifs. Prominently featured on the side of the glass is a painted bird, with a white body, black wing markings, a red tail, and a red patch on its back. The bird also has a gray head, and it stands on a green base-like element as part of the design. The background is a plain, off-white color, and there is a small, faint sketch of the same glass in the bottom right of the image, annotated with the number “9.” The composition centers the glass vertically, and all decorative elements are rendered in gouache or watercolor.
title: Vase
